metadata.description: Create device sensor (V1). Empty 201 body; new sensor UUID only in Location header (quirk 6-style, not body-decoded). Live-captured against <internal-env>/26.2.0.0, org 138883 (sdktest). Sensor name required an undocumented ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]+$ pattern (swagger declares no pattern; its own canonical example 'Battery health' violates it -- same server-side constraint as V2's sibling fixture). Location header's path is /api/mdm/devicesensors?organizationGroupId=138883/{uuid} -- the query string from the create call's own URL is embedded ahead of the appended UUID segment, a real server quirk, not a capture artifact.
